AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MEETING
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING – 633 E. Broadway, Room 105 (MSB 105)
  Glendale, CA 91206

Welcome to the meeting of the Civil Service Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the
week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and Videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by
  calling (818) 548-2090. Please turn off cellular phones and pagers while inside the Council Chambers.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are
available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
  for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services.

All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will
  be available for review in the Human Resources office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 100, Glendale, CA 91206.

  If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact Human Resources at (818) 548-2110 during
  regular business hours.

  February 12, 2020 at 5:00 p.m.
  1.  ROLL CALL

  2.  MINUTES (Page 3)
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of December 11, 2019.

  3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes.
  Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT (Page 6)
  No action required.

  5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED (Page 8)
  No action required.

  6.  REORGANIZATION OF THE COMMISSION
  Action: Select new Commission Chair and Vice-Chair.

  7.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL – ADMINISTRATIVE SPECIALIST / CDD SERIES (CHAVEZ)
  (Page 9)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Administrative Specialist / CDD Series as submitted.

  8.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL – SUSTAINABILITY OFFICER (NAVARRO) (Page 18)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Sustainability Officer as submitted.

  9.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL – POLICE CUSTODY OFFICER / LATERAL (CHAVEZ) (Page 23)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Police Custody Officer / Lateral as submitted.

  10. JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL – BUDGET ANALYST (NAVARRO) (Page 29)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Budget Analyst as submitted.
   11. REPORTS – INFORMATION (Page 35)
  a) Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations.

  12. CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS

  13. ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

As required by law, this agenda for the Civil Service Commission Meeting of February 12, 2020 was posted at
or before 4:00 p.m. on February 7, 2020 on the City Hall Bulletin Board.
